parsed.note_claim: These low budget mascot costumes are worn by scammers who solicit money for photos, usually in New York.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Unlicensed and unpaid, these stand-ins for Deadpool, Spongebob Squarepants and the like subsist on tips from posing for photos.
parsed.reason: The article confirms that unlicensed costumed performers in Times Square, New York, solicit tips for photos and are not official employees.
